title: Bachelor of Commerce, General
description: The Wits BCom includes compulsory first-year courses that build foundational knowledge in Economics, Accounting, Commercial Law, Information Systems, and Introductory Mathematics and Business Statistics. These courses prepare students for a career in the commercial and related sectors of any economy. It is a double major degree, requiring at least two full majors, with the option to explore three potential majors in the second year. Students can choose majors from Commerce, Law, and Management (CLM), or select a second major from other faculties like Science or Humanities. The degree offers flexibility, allowing students to change majors or move between specialized BCom degrees if needed, and does not require committing to major choices in the first year.

title: Bachelor of Commerce, Information Systems
description: The pervasiveness of technology in the knowledge economy has resulted in increasing demand for professionals with a unique blend of analytical, technical, business and communication skills. In Information Systems, the programme studies what happens when technologies, people, organisations and societies interact. It focuses on the design of end-to-end solutions where technology may be an element, differentiating it from disciplines like Information Technology, Computer Science, and Software Engineering. The analytical, technical, business and communication skills gained can lead to a wide range of career choices.

title: Bachelor of Commerce, Politics, Philosophy and Economics
description: The Bachelor of Commerce in Politics, Philosophy and Economics combines foundational commerce courses with interdisciplinary studies in politics, philosophy, and economics. It builds critical thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills through exploring the intersections of these fields. Students gain a broad understanding of societal, ethical, and economic issues, preparing them for diverse roles in policy, business, and public service. The programme emphasizes real-world applications and debate, fostering intellectual agility for global challenges.

title: Bachelor of Administration
description: This degree focuses on public sector management, preparing students with knowledge and skills in governance, policy implementation, and public administration. It develops competencies for effective management in government institutions and public service organizations.
faculty: Faculty of Economic and Management Sciences

title: Bachelor of Commerce
description: A comprehensive business degree that provides foundational knowledge in commerce, economics, and business management. Students gain broad business skills applicable across various industries and sectors.
faculty: Faculty of Economic and Management Sciences

title: Bachelor of Administration specialising in Public Administration
description: This degree equips students with knowledge and skills in public sector management, governance, and policy-making. It prepares graduates for careers in government, international relations, and public service leadership.
faculty: Faculty of Economic and Management Sciences
careers: local government and the private sector

title: Bachelor of Commerce in Accounting Sciences
description: This degree provides a strong foundation in financial reporting, auditing, taxation, and management accounting. It is the entry point for students wishing to qualify as Chartered Accountants (SA).
faculty: Faculty of Economic and Management Sciences
